room.name: The Tide Keeps Time
room.hint: Every basin keeps its own tide. A float rides the sea up to the thorns above: leave in time. Drowned thorns are safe only while the sea covers them. Crumbling stone gives no grace.

bank.author: Claude; revised by Sol 6.1
bank.role: Landing Shores Core: every basin keeps its own sea
bank.solution: Wavedash from the rising float across the reef. Leave the three relay floats before their thorn ceilings, detour around the spout bar, descend with the staggered tides, and launch from the last sea into the low seed approach.
bank.coreDescription: Every basin keeps its own sea. Leave on the tide, not after it.
bank.humanReview: Revision 3: native full and all six fresh checkpoint routes verified, with airborne float wavedash, 600 bounded ordinary launch probes, and three relay ceiling deadlines. Local draft awaiting batch integration and player review.
